mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference images, each for one purpose.
Reference image 1 shows an outrigger canoe moored on a beach: draw this SAME canoe on its own, keeping its construction, materials, colours and proportions identical: a long narrow dark-brown wooden dugout hull with visible wood grain and a slightly raised pointed bow and stern, two straight lashed cross-poles laid across the hull and tied with rope lashings, the poles reaching out to one side to a long slim log float lashed beneath their ends, and a single wooden paddle laid lengthwise inside along the bottom of the hull. Leave out the beach, the water, the stones, the mooring post and the forest.
Reference image 2 is a style reference only: match its ink linework, flat colour fills and palette; do not copy its subject or composition.
View: three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole boat including both ends of the hull and the whole float inset well inside the frame, the boat placed diagonally to fit the tall card.
Style: vanilla Card Survival item art: flat posterized colour fills in a few tonal steps, thin dark ink outlines, small ink hatch marks for wood texture, muted naturalistic browns, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no gloss. Single subject with a generous white margin on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) filling every edge, no ground shadow, no scenery. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: water, waves, beach, sand, pebbles, rocks, mooring post, trees, sky, people, sail, mast, second float, footprints, tracks, prints in the ground, cropped bow or stern, photo, photorealistic, 3D render, anime, neon colours, scenery behind the subject, grey background, off-white background, checkerboard, transparency grid, text, watermark, border.
